content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Batch Jobs ## slug: events-admin-batch-jobs ## seoTitle: Batch Jobs ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End The following batch jobs can be initiated from the {{variable.Tab_ET_BTEventAdmin}}'s {{variable.Tab_BTETAdmin_BatchJobs}} tab. :::(Warning) (**Do you need help while using the Blackthorn | Events Admin page?**) Click the blue and white icon located on the bottom right side of your screen, and speak to one of our team members via Chat. ::: ### Add Sort Order on Event Items Button * Apex Class Name: EventItem_SetSortOrder * Clicking this button sets the {{variable.Field_EventItem_SortOrder}} field on {{variable.Object_EventItem}} records when the {{variable.Field_EventItem_SortOrder}} field is blank. ### Register Attendees for Webinars Button * Batch Job Name: Blackthorn | Events Attendee Webinar Registration * Use this button to register your {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s with your webinar provider so your {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s receive a personalized URL to join the webinar. ### Process Form Submissions Button Clicking this button will trigger the following batch jobs. * Batch Job Name: Blackthorn | Events FormSubmission Processing0 * Runs at the top of each hour (12:00, 1:00, 2:00, etc.) * Batch Job Name: Blackthorn | Events FormSubmission Processing53 * Runs approximately every 5 minutes ### Create Webinars for Events Button * Batch Job Name: Create Webinars for Events * Use this job to create webinars for {{variable.Object_Event}}s with a value in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinMeetingAcct}} field and no value in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} field. ### Create Webinars for Sessions Button * Apex Class Name: WebinarCreateBatch * Use this job to create webinars for {{variable.Object_Session}}s with a value in the {{variable.Field_Session_WebinarMeetiAcct}} field and no value in the {{variable.Field_Session_WebinarMtgURL}} field.
